people.name: Pelusium
people.line: An Egyptian city, also known as Sin

people.name: Thebes
people.line: Ancient Egyptian city, known for its wealth and power

translations.web: I will set a fire in Egypt Sin will be in great anguish. No will be broken up. Memphis will have adversaries in the daytime.
translations.bsb: I will set fire to Egypt, Pelusium will writhe in anguish, Thebes will be split open, and Memphis will face daily distress.
translations.kjv: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.
translations.asv: And I will set a fire in Egypt: Sin shall be in great anguish, and No shall be broken up; and Memphis shall have adversaries in the day-time.
